name: Secure Hosting Freeport IDC
notes: Secure Hosting says it operates data centers in Nassau, Freeport and Hamilton and owns/maintains the equipment and infrastructure. Bahamas Investor/PRNewswire reported the Freeport data centre opened on 2013-04-24; Data Center Map lists it at Poinciana Dr & E Mall, Freeport, with Tier 3, PCI DSS, multi-tenant retrofitted building and operational year 2013. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Cloud Carib Freeport data centre / CaribPod facility
notes: Cloud Carib official pages state its data centres are located in Nassau and Freeport in The Bahamas and that Cloud Carib operates CaribPods in secure regional data centres with redundant power/cooling and 24/7 support. A 2017-07-06 Cloud Carib release also identified existing data centers in Nassau and Freeport. No facility address or MW capacity disclosed; likely a managed cloud/sovereign cloud deployment rather than a hyperscale campus.
